_comment: Spell NAMES (as they appear in mythicsim-forever-engine/data/spells.jsonl) that Forte_Mage tracks. gen_spell_data.py resolves each to its highest-rank spell ID + current duration/cooldown data. Names with no match in a given build are reported by the generator, not silently dropped. Forever spellings are verbatim (Darnassus, Thunder Bluff, Orgrimmar). Forever renames/new vs Cata: Arcane Channel->Evocation, Blink->Displacement, Cauterize->Rewind Time, Cold Blood(frost)->Icy Veins, Time Warp->Temporal Anomaly, Arcane Spirit->Arcane Brilliance (Arcane Intellect also present), new fire armor Molten Armor, new spells Frozen Orb / Living Flame / Arcane Surge / Mass Regeneration / Netherwind Focus / Chronostatic Preservation / Evoker / Regeneration. The priest-side spells Circle of Healing / Eye of the Void / Homunculi / Power Word: Barrier / Void Plague also exist here as cross-class Mage talent rows; the generator's family-scoped rank resolution keeps them on the Priest lists. Crowd control rides `utility` (Counterspell, and Polymorph since 2026-11-02 -- CodeReview4 E4: the spell's real Family=3 rows (base 118 + ranks 12824-12826) were simply omitted, which left the Poly fade/break rows of Forte_Messages' raid page with no Spell Timer row to ring on; the Spell Tracker's registry gates on durationMs > 0, rank 4's 50000 ms qualifies it). T1 (2026-11-02, docs/class-port.md 6.1 + PLAN 11.1 Q1/Q6 rulings): the reference's CAST spells are added -- cooldowns += Combustion, Cone of Cold, Frost Nova, Deep Freeze, Blast Wave, Fire Blast, Arcane Blast; buffs += Blizzard, Living Bomb, Pyroblast, Flamestrike, Frostfire Bolt and the family-less Q6 Freeze row. The reference's proc/passive names (see _deferred_H7) ride with H7 (docs/design-combat-procs.md); Mana Surge is on that list because its only row (23572) is filed Family 11 (Shaman) -- the family law leaves it a gap here, and the shaman list does not name it either. Wave I-2b (2026-11-03, upstream-data §5.1 + Blizzard dev notes post 9): [cooldowns] += Ice Lance -- post 9 puts it on Fire Blast's shared category 19 with an 8 s cooldown, and the 70707 store carries exactly that (1312002/400640/1240044-47 Category 19 / CategoryCooldownMs 8000; the 70425 base ranks 400616-23 say 15000 for the same category -- the store rows win the pick, upstream-data §5 row 10). Wave I-3 H7 (2026-11-03, upstream-data §3.1/§7.3, fx-worker I3e): Fingers of Frost and Ignite MOVED OUT of _deferred_H7 into [buffs] -- the wowsims MIT names.json keys mage fingers_of_frost at 400669 and ignite at 412538, and the base carrier rows carry exactly the §3.1 store durations (15000 and 4000; the value-less 400647/401741/11119 shells ride beneath them). The three kept _deferred_H7 names have no names.json key (§3.1 Unresolvable): Brain Freeze (the 400731/401725 base rows are value-less), Chilled (a frost slow family, 6136/7321/16927 5 s + 12484 1.5 s -- a target-side slow whose 2026 keying is a probe) and Mana Surge (family law: its only row 23572 is filed Family 11, a generator gap here). In-combat the proc windows are sealed aura reads -- Forte_Timer/Core/Reconcile.lua Gates() (:78-92) runs zero aura reads in combat, a sealed read changes nothing (:158-176).
